about_the_game:
SANCTUM PROTOCOL – NSFW visual novel with dark sci-fi and mystical eroticism

After the event known as The Breach, portals opened to a dimension of corrupt pleasure, allowing female demonic entities to disrupt the spiritual balance of Earth. Humanity's only hope lies with religious military orders, such as the Order of the White Lance: warrior nuns who combine faith, sacred technology, and physical combat to contain the corruption.

You play as a young civilian who, after a supernatural encounter with a succubus, discovers you possess the power of the legendary Guardian: purifying demons through the body. The nuns believe you might be the key to saving humanity… but a mysterious and powerful figure watches your every move. Every choice you make will affect your power, your corruption, and the fate of the world.

Key Features:

  • Adult visual novel with moral, sexual, and spiritual choices that lead to multiple paths and endings.

  • Corruption and Purification system: purify demons through pleasure and explore the fine line between salvation and corruption.

  • Explore the Sanctuary and the city: library, confessional, laboratory, dormitories, altar, and forbidden zones.

  • Deep relationships with the main nuns: Sister Elysia, Noa, Malina, and Caelia, with romance, betrayal, and mutual corruption routes.

  • Dream visions that gradually reveal the prophecy and the origin of the Sanctum Protocolum.

  • Psycho-erotic abilities unlocked as your corruption grows.

  • Dark, provocative anime-style artwork, carefully reviewed and curated for consistency and quality.

content_descriptors.notes: Sanctum Protocol is an adult visual novel featuring explicit sexual content and moderate violence. It includes erotic scenes with female characters, consensual romantic and sexual interactions within the narrative, as well as themes of corruption, manipulation, and moral dilemmas. The story also explores sensitive topics such as religious fanaticism, spiritual corruption, and ethically complex decisions. No non-consensual sexual abuse, recreational drugs, or self-harm are depicted, but players should be aware of the adult and psychologically intense nature of the story.
